goal: Accept valid 65-byte Taproot SIGHASH_ALL signatures when the sighash type is omitted in a PSBT input
Allow PSBTs created by external Taproot signers to be signed further or finalized without errors
agreement: Tested ACK on Windows without detailed rationale (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes false rejections of valid Taproot signatures during PSBT signing and finalization
Prevents signing workflows from failing when external signers omit the sighash type field
